removal.$description: Brief visible gap after an item is removed, before surrounding items reflow. State changes immediately; skip the gap for keyboard and reduced-motion interactions.

repeat.$description: Recognize consecutive pointer actions within 500ms as a repeat sequence, independently of visual transition duration.

scroll-idle.$description: Restore pointer hover after scrolling has been idle for 120ms. Trailing wheel input at a boundary does not extend this interval; keyboard focus stays visible.
